testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect and dismisses available design views for a part ✔ Given the user opens a writable copy of `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd`, creates named views Open Dialog Blue and Open Dialog Neutral, saves and closes it ✔ Given the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a saved part with named design views is selected ✔ And its Design View field displays Last Active ✔ And the saved working native part has named design views `Open Dialog Blue` and `Open Dialog Neutral` ✔ When the user opens the Design View list ✔ Then Last Active, the primary view, and the part's named design views are displayed ✔ And the part preview remains visible ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the Design View list closes ✔ And the Design View field still displays Last Active ✔ And the Open dialog remains open
